description: H1. The effective ceiling is the minimum over every level, not the number the leaf declares. The agent's 600.00 binds although the department permits 800.00 and the company 1000.00 — a child cannot raise anything, and the number a controller reads on the leaf is not the number in force.
clock_note: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, the first instant of a fixed month at UTC+00:00

requests.note: Permitted by both levels above it and refused by the one below them.
min(1000.00, 800.00, 600.00) — the number an interface must show.
